# Extract movie blocks: lines 'Title' then '-' lines. We'll parse by finding lines not starting with '#' or '-' or blank.
lines=[l.strip() for l in content.splitlines()]
# Identify title lines: non-empty, not starting with '#', not starting with '-', not starting with ' '.
titles=[]
current_title=None
current_is_tarantino=False
for l in lines:
    if not l: continue
    if l.startswith('#'): continue
    if l.startswith('-'):
        if l.lower().startswith('- director:'):
            director=l.split(':',1)[1].strip()
            current_is_tarantino = (director.lower()=='quentin tarantino')
        continue
    # title line
    current_title=l
    current_is_tarantino=False
    titles.append(l)

# Instead of flawed above, do proper parse: read title, then scan director line until next title.
movies=[]
current=None
current_director=None
for l in lines:
    if not l or l.startswith('#'): continue
    if l.startswith('-'):
        if l.lower().startswith('- director:'):
            current_director=l.split(':',1)[1].strip()
    else:
        # new title
        if current is not None:
            movies.append((current,current_director))
        current=l
        current_director=None
# append last
if current is not None:
    movies.append((current,current_director))

print('parsed_movies', len(movies))
# filter director == Quentin Tarantino
selected=[title for title,dirr in movies if (dirr or '').lower()=='quentin tarantino']
print('selected', selected)
message=', '.join(selected)
print('message', message)
